claims.claim: Section 102 capital gains track taxes the entire gain at a flat 25% (or 30% for controlling shareholders holding 10%+).
claims.source_name: PWC Israel Individual Income Determination
claims.raw_snippet: preferential capital gains tax rate of 25%

claims.claim: Section 102 trustee 24-month holding period is counted from the END OF THE TAX YEAR OF GRANT (December 31 of grant year), not from the grant date itself.
claims.source_name: NASPP Israel Section 102
claims.note: End-of-tax-year clock-start is the established ITA interpretation; numerous Israeli tax-firm publications confirm this. PwC and the kolzchut treatment of Section 102 both state the period runs from the end of the tax year of grant.
claims.raw_snippet: the trustee must hold for a minimum of 24 months

claims.claim: 2026 surtax (mas yasaf) threshold is 721,560 NIS/year. Above that threshold: 3% general surtax on all income + additional 2% surtax on capital income (effective since 2025).
claims.source_name: PWC Israel Individual Other Taxes
claims.raw_snippet: additional 2% surtax on capital income over ILS 721,561, bringing the total surtax to 5%

claims.claim: 2026 Israeli income tax brackets after the April 2026 retroactive widening: bracket 3 (20%) covers monthly 10,061-19,000 (annual 120,721-228,000); bracket 4 (31%) covers 19,001-25,100 monthly (228,001-301,200 annual).

The next tax bracket, 31%... will be revised upwards to NIS 25,100 | Full 2026 annual bracket table: 10% up to 84,120; 14% 84,121-120,720; 20% 120,721-228,000; 31% 228,001-301,200; 35% 301,201-560,280; 47% 560,281-721,560; 50% above 721,560. Monthly boundaries 7,010 / 10,060 / 19,000 / 25,100 / 46,690 / 60,130.

claims.claim: Bituach Leumi maximum monthly income subject to contributions for SALARIED employees (shakhir) in 2026 is 51,910 NIS. The reduced-rate ceiling (60% of the average wage) is 7,703 NIS/month.
claims.source_name: Kol-Zchut Bituach Leumi for Salaried Employees
claims.note: 49,030 NIS/month is the corresponding 2026 ceiling for self-employed (atzma'i); the skill applies to salaried tech employees so 51,910 is the correct figure.
claims.raw_snippet: Income above 7,703 ₪ up to 51,910 ₪ is subject to the full National Insurance contribution rate (2026)

claims.claim: For a resident salaried employee aged 18 to retirement (column 1 of the BL rate table), the 2026 employee contribution is: reduced tier (up to 7,703/month) National Insurance 1.04% + health 3.23% = 4.27% total; full tier (7,703-51,910/month) National Insurance 7.0% + health 5.17% = 12.17% total. The reduced-tier NI rate (1.04%) and full-tier health rate (5.17%) reflect the temporary order in force for 2025-2026.
claims.source_name: Bituach Leumi official rate table for salaried employees
claims.note: Confirmed by rendering the official BL salaried-worker rate table (column 1). Corrects the prior pre-2025 figures (0.4%/3.1%/7.0%/5.0%) that survived in the v1.1.0 reference file.
claims.raw_snippet: מחלק השכר שעד מדרגת גביה מופחתת (שיעור מופחת) - 7,703 ... סך הכול עובד 4.27% ... שיעור מלא ... סך הכול עובד 12.17% Employer contribution: reduced 4.51%, full 7.6%. Ceiling 51,910 ש"ח/חודש, reduced-rate ceiling 7,703 ש"ח. Prior (pre-2025) employee rates were 0.4% / 3.1% / 7.0% / 5.0% with totals 3.5% and 12.0%.

claims.claim: Section 102(b)(3): for a company whose shares are LISTED on a stock exchange at the grant date, or registered for trading within 90 days after the grant,, the capital-gains track still applies but the gain is mandatorily bifurcated. The ordinary-income component equals the average closing share value over the 30 trading days preceding the grant date (less any exercise price) and is taxed at marginal rates + Bituach Leumi + health + surtax; only the excess over that grant-date average is taxed at 25%. Private companies at grant are taxed at a flat 25% on the whole gain.
claims.source_name: Baker McKenzie Global Equity Matrix - Israel RS/RSU (Section 102(b)(3))
claims.note: The 30-day-preceding-grant ordinary-income component under the capital-gains track for listed companies is the §102(b)(3) rule; the income-track 30-day-preceding-settlement average is the separate Baker McKenzie RSU claim already in this file. 90-day-after-grant arm added per expert review.
claims.raw_snippet: the average value of the Stock for the 30 trading days preceding ... is taxable to the employee as ordinary income The statute also captures shares registered for trading on an exchange within 90 days after the date of grant (שנרשמו למסחר בבורסה בתוך 90 יום ממועד ההקצאה).

claims.claim: Capital gains track does NOT apply Bituach Leumi or health insurance to the gain. Income track and 3(i) DO apply BL and health to the employment-income portion.
claims.source_name: BDO Israel ESOP Reporting
claims.raw_snippet: Capital gains track does NOT apply Bituach Leumi or health insurance to the gain. Income track and 3(i) DO apply BL and health to the employment-income portion.

claims.claim: Section 102 'controlling shareholder' definition triggers at 10%+ holdings (current or historical) and raises the capital gains rate to 30%.
claims.source_name: PWC Israel Other Taxes
claims.raw_snippet: Section 102 'controlling shareholder' definition triggers at 10%+ holdings (current or historical) and raises the capital gains rate to 30%.

claims.claim: Early sale before the 24-month period elapses voids the capital gains track election and the ENTIRE gain is reclassified as employment income, taxed at marginal rates + BL + health + surtax.
claims.source_name: Pearl Cohen Section 102 pitfalls
claims.raw_snippet: Early sale before the 24-month period elapses voids the capital gains track election and the ENTIRE gain is reclassified as employment income, taxed at marginal rates + BL + health + surtax.

claims.claim: Under the 2024-2025 amendment effective January 1, 2025, Section 102 plan filings are online-only, the ITA performs red-flag screening, and put/call plans can obtain advance approval.
claims.source_name: Herzog Law - New and Amended 102 Rules
claims.raw_snippet: Income Tax Rules (Tax Relief in Allocating Shares to Employees) (Amendment), 2024... coming into effect on January 1, 2025

claims.claim: Section 102 plan grants can only be made starting 30 days AFTER the plan is submitted to the ITA (not 30 days after board approval). Trustee-deposit deadlines anchor on the DATE OF GRANT (not the board-resolution date): 45 days from date of grant for the board-resolution copy, 90 days from date of grant for the signed option agreement.
claims.source_name: Gornitzky GNY - Section 102 Administrative Requirements
claims.note: Corrected from prior 'deposit within 30 days of board approval' wording in the v1.0.2 reference file. Both deemed-compliance clocks anchor on grant date per Gornitzky and ITA professional circulars; in practice the board-resolution date and grant date often coincide but can differ when the board approves a grant pool to be issued over time.
claims.raw_snippet: within 45 days and 90 days, respectively, from the date of grant

claims.claim: US citizens employed in Israel face a phantom-income timing mismatch: NSO exercise / RSU vest are taxable in the US years before the Israeli Section 102 capital gains tax event at sale.
claims.source_name: Tax4US - 5 Critical Tax Traps for Americans in Israel
claims.raw_snippet: You are required to pay significant tax in the U.S. on 'phantom income' years before you saw a single shekel in practice, and before a taxable event even occurred in Israel

claims.claim: Under the US-Israel tax treaty (1995), Israel has primary taxing rights on Israeli-source employment income (including stock-based compensation earned while working in Israel). US citizens can claim Foreign Tax Credit via Form 1116.
claims.source_name: VestingStrategy - Israel Equity Compensation Tax Guide
claims.raw_snippet: US citizens must coordinate Israeli tax with US worldwide reporting; foreign tax credits and timing differences are common

claims.claim: Section 100A (Israeli exit tax) treats unsold assets, including unvested options and unsold 102 shares, as deemed-sold one day before cessation of Israeli residency. The employee can elect to defer payment until actual sale.
claims.source_name: Nahum-Deutsch CPA - Exit Tax
claims.raw_snippet: the assets of a person ceasing to be an Israeli resident shall be deemed to have been sold one day before they ceased to be an Israeli resident

claims.claim: Stock-for-stock acquisitions can qualify for Section 104H tax-deferred rollover: no Israeli tax at the merger, cost basis carries over to acquirer shares, 24-month clock and capital gains track election are preserved.
claims.source_name: VestingStrategy Israel guide
claims.note: Section 104H is the standard 'corporate restructuring' rollover provision in the Israeli Income Tax Ordinance; widely documented across Israeli M&A practice.
claims.raw_snippet: Stock-for-stock acquisitions can qualify for Section 104H tax-deferred rollover: no Israeli tax at the merger, cost basis carries over to acquirer shares, 24-month clock and capital gains track election are preserved.

claims.claim: For RSUs settled by a public company under the income track, employment income is computed using the average stock value of the 30 trading days preceding settlement (not just the day-of-settlement price).
claims.source_name: Baker McKenzie Global Equity Matrix - Israel RS/RSU
claims.raw_snippet: the average value of the Stock for the 30 trading days preceding the settlement of the RSUs is taxable to the employee as ordinary income
